body:
Source-derived follow-up to #825, discovered read-only at7a87b33115c0cd45b14cac64d7b37e5742503159. No measured token, application-fit or memory gain is established. This is a bounded real-consumer step; it cannot close all of #825 by itself.

The first report::Owner acquisition reserves backing before any report Vec exists (src/workspace_graph/constructor_failure/report.rs:115–141); its initial failure returns Setup (attempt.rs:30–36), then compatibility receiving materializes a Vec (receiving.rs:75–107). A nonempty owned Vec cannot be returned allocation-free at zero available ownership. Preacquiring another owner merely moves that base case unless genuine caller storage already exists.

Carry an opaque initial admission/failure channel through the existing semantic_workspace::reporting::preflight -> preflight_typed -> retaining-source builder -> build_owned_inner -> constructor attempt chain. Extend existing WorkspaceReportFailure privately and use typed builder twins rather than adding an unused endpoint. Preserve received report ownership, complete ordered LegacyMany payloads, and unreceived primary/owner without reclassification or implicit Vec conversion. Retain snapshot/Vec APIs as explicit allocating compatibility routes.

Exact invocation context must survive restoration: build_owned_inner creates its scope at workspace_graph.rs:3911, but diagnostics/invocation.rs:22–32 drops current TLS strings assuming help was already copied. Returning only numeric receipts and formatting after restoration would read another invocation. Move the exact existing context into the carrier, or render before restoration into genuinely authenticated caller backing. Do not clone or recertify the original context allocation as paid.

Acceptance: real existing reporting consumer adopts the typed chain; all six diagnostic fields/order and exact dynamic help remain byte-equivalent through foreign/restored/nested/sticky/multiple-error cases; no implicit compatibility Vec allocation on initial typed refusal. Observe allocations including carrier lifetime/Drop and preserve complete independent old receivers. Authenticate any received owner before borrowing/taking. Explicitly disclose any still-unpaid inline carrier/context/output control storage. No cap change, numeric-limit payer, donor budget, refund, dropped error, fallback allocation disguised as funding, or scope reclassification. Existing compatibility allocation and fully funded output remain #825 residuals; do not close that parent from this subtask. Add only focused owning controls and scoped Clippy at the consolidated batch; regenerate moved pins with actual producers/consumers.
title: (OPT) Preserve constructor admission failures through existing typed workspace reporting
